name: hkfes-monorepo
description: HKFES — Full-Stack Professional Trading Platform (PWA + REST/WebSocket API)

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'start'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test

author: HKFES Team
